claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, linking reusable workflow capabilities with usage-based forecasting and customer deal support.
Strengthened production reliability with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows, combining evaluation gates, runtime telemetry, and rollback controls.
Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates across intake, execution, monitoring, and remediation, enabling managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms by integrating AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines with vector services and resilient execution layers.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.
